title: QUIZ - 35
description: Test your knowledge, strengthen your reasoning, and learn something new with every question.

questions.learningObjective: Count the number of terms in an algebraic expression
questions.question: How many terms are in the expression \( 8n + 4n + 3n \)?
questions.explanation: Terms are separated by + or - signs. Counting the parts of \( 8n + 4n + 3n \) gives 3 terms.
questions.hint: Terms are the parts of an expression separated by addition or subtraction signs.

questions.learningObjective: Distinguish between the variable, coefficient, and constant in an expression
questions.question: In the expression \( 7x + 8 \), which part represents the coefficient?
questions.explanation: In \( 7x + 8 \), 7 is the coefficient, x is the variable, and 8 is the constant term.
questions.hint: Recall the definitions: the coefficient multiplies the variable; the constant has no variable.

questions.learningObjective: Identify the constant term in an algebraic expression
questions.question: In the expression \( 3a - 22 \), what is the constant term?
questions.explanation: The constant term is the part of the expression with no variable attached, which is -22.
questions.hint: The constant term does not have a variable attached to it.
